metaTitle: Custom Golf Pocket Utility Knives | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom golf pocket utility knives for your next tournament or event. Perfect for bulk branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom golf pocket utility knives are a practical giveaway for tournaments, corporate outings, and club events. Unlike standard pocket knives, these are designed with golfers in mind—compact enough to fit in a bag pocket, with features like a divot tool or bottle opener. Choose from stainless steel or aluminum handles, and add your logo with laser engraving or pad printing for a polished look that stands out on the course.
heroAltText: Custom golf pocket utility knife with engraved logo, compact design perfect for tournament giveaways
